facts.text: Gotham, tonight's parade is on me. Come hungry, and keep your hands off the hair gel.
facts.why: Not a Joker line. The quote page has lines such as 'If you've gotta go, go with a smile!' and 'Wait till they get a load of ME!' Printed in quote marks and signed The Joker.
facts.fix: If you've gotta go, go with a smile!

facts.text: Smilex in the hair gel and lipstick
facts.why: The film spells it Smylex. Sources say the Joker poisons cosmetics and hygiene products but do not name hair gel.
facts.fix: Smylex in the cosmetics, laughing all the way

facts.why: The Joker's bicentennial parade is confirmed, but no source gives a time of 11:30.

facts.text: Vicki's lunch table, before the Joker redecorates.
facts.why: The Joker lures Vicki to the Flugelheim Museum and his men vandalise it. No source has a lunch scene.
facts.fix: Vicki at the Flugelheim, before the Joker redecorates.

facts.text: Vicki's order, waiting on her mystery lunch date.
facts.why: No lunch scene or mystery date appears in the plot sources.
facts.fix: Vicki's order at the museum gala, before the paint flies.

vibe.verdict: Smart parade cue and a nice cafe, but it skips the Joker's best moments and leans on a lunch scene that is not in the film.
missing: 'Where does he get those wonderful toys?'
The Joker defacing the paintings in the museum (and sparing the Francis Bacon)
The long dinner table at Wayne Manor
Batman and the Joker on the cathedral roof
ideas: Swap 'Gotham back-street Reuben' for a 'Francis Bacon bacon roll', note 'I kind of like this one. Leave it.'
Swap 'Smoked trout rillettes' note for 'Vicki and Bruce at the very long table.'
Swap 'Kir royale' note for 'Vicki at the gala, before the Joker arrives.'
